observations.summary: Reuters reports Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar and took positions in its center under a negotiated arrangement with Kataib Hezbollah, moving beyond the prior day's agreement into observable implementation. Militia withdrawal and durable transfer of control remain unverified. This is a potentially consequential de-escalation in an armed standoff, not proof of militia disarmament.
observations.title: Iraqi government forces deploy inside Kataib Hezbollah-held Jurf al-Sakhar
